scope: Selected Seoul-to-Suwon SUMO route only; read-only comparison against archived OSM restrictions and OSRM geometry.
result: No confirmed turn-restriction violation was found on the selected route. Relation 16705869 cannot be resolved because its archived source lacks via/to members.
method: Inspect all archived restriction relations, not only the warning lines: netconvert aggregates repeated warning messages.
Map SUMO external edge IDs to OSM way IDs by removing the leading direction sign and split suffix; retain the sign for same-way U-turn checks.
Inspect direct from/to transitions and via-way sequences for no_* restrictions whose from-way is on the route.
Inspect the only_straight_on restriction at a joined junction against its raw source node/way geometry; do not mistake an absorbed internal way for an omitted mandatory turn.
Sum passenger-allowed internal lane lengths for each adjacent external edge pair, including secondary via lanes; report the min/max across lane choices.

Compare polylines sampled approximately every 20m using point-to-segment nearest distances in SUMO projected coordinates. External edge gaps are straight interpolations for this comparison, so it is an approximate geometry comparison.

ignored_relations_touching_route.finding: Only the to-way is on the selected route; the forbidden from/via approach is not traversed.
Raw Overpass tile itself contains only from-way 518362768. No via/to member exists to determine the forbidden maneuver; no guessed correction was made.

joined_junction_restriction_review.finding: Both endpoints of required to-way 497290500 belong to the same joined junction. The selected connection continues south to 251118733, matching the raw straight-through geometry; its absence as an external route edge is not a confirmed violation.

length_comparison_m.interpretation: About 3.35km of junction-internal links explains most of the apparent 34.99km versus 38.52km difference. The remaining difference reflects distinct routing/lane geometry and should not be described as exactly the same path.

limitations: Incomplete source relation 16705869 prevents a complete turn-restriction assurance for its from-way.
This audit compares archived source tags and generated topology; it does not verify current road signs or legal restrictions against official traffic records.
Per-transition min/max internal lengths need not represent one globally feasible lane sequence; the bounds are a distance explanation, while an actual SUMO drive validates the final lane sequence.
